evidence: CTX1 and T0/T3 sequence/choice cover active-service investigation, outage credit, supervisor, cancellation and owned unknown outcomes; cash payouts and network repair excluded.
Every leaf T1,T2,T3.1,T3.2,T3.3,T4 is served by C/W and goldens. FM1-FM9 links derive from EV1-EV23 and are reciprocal. Source brief exact quote; H1-H6 separate proposed policies and adapters.

W6 durable timers, W5 notice scheduling, W7 actual send, W10 all unknown paths reconcile, same-key one retry after final absence; W14 proof before W15; W16 owned unresolved terminal. EV6 now CREDITED plus cancellation flag.

C1-C9 define scope/evidence/status fields, required immutable command content, write response enums, 5s adapter deadlines, durable queue acknowledgement/escalation and read-only lookup beyond session.

C1 and C7 scope/active joins precede private reads and credit. C4 exact approved command, C7 fresh versions/authority and atomic uniqueness; C3 has explanation-only output with citation verification. H4 privacy is explicit launch gate.

H1-H4/H6 block launch on unverified policy, integration, staffing, privacy and notice evidence. H5/M1 illustrative volume/prices and all fixtures synthetic. Missing/conflicting records yield owned investigation.

F1 rejects open-ended/synchronous chain for durable code state machine; same comparison criteria persistence/timers/dedup/authority/recovery. F2 scopes principals; F3 compares relational/evidence/audit patterns across cloud/open-source as unverified candidates.

EV1 valid arithmetic, EV2 wrong customer, EV3/14 stale/revoked, EV4 two concurrent operations, EV5/20 conflict/invented citation, EV6/16 uncertain/logout/cancel, EV7 proof failure, EV8 48h queue, EV9 missing policy, EV10/11/15 notices, EV12 cap overflow, EV13 signed supervisor, EV17 cancel, EV18 inactive, EV19 speed.
